card.name: Section numbers before subsection headings
card.fires_on: The digit or period in a subsection number such as 2.3, 5.6 or 5.11, placed right before a new section heading. It appears in label text where numbered subsections follow one another.

modes.label: Digit in section number
modes.description: The final digit of a number like 5.6 or 5.11 just before the heading text.

modes.label: Period after section number
modes.description: The period after a number like 2.3 or 2.10 where the subsection title follows.

card.plain: It marks the number of a new numbered subsection in a drug label, just before the heading begins.
